test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: To attract investments from across the globe and strengthen India's manufacturing sector was the main objective of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Make In India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Make In India** was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on **25th September 2014**.
 
• The initiative aims to transform India into a global design and manufacturing hub by encouraging both multinational as well as domestic companies to manufacture their products within India.
 
• It focuses on 25 sectors of the economy, which include automobiles, chemicals, IT, pharmaceuticals, textiles, ports, aviation, leather, tourism and hospitality, wellness, railways, and more.
 
• The primary goal is to attract investments from across the globe, create job opportunities, and boost the economy by making India a manufacturing powerhouse.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Startup India**

 
 
• Launched on January 16, 2016, the Startup India initiative aims to build a strong ecosystem for nurturing innovation and startups in the country.
 
• It provides various benefits such as tax exemptions, easier compliance, IPR fast-tracking, and funding support.
 
• The initiative is intended to promote entrepreneurship and job creation, focusing on smaller startups and young businesses.
 
 
 
• **Digital India**
 
 
• Launched on July 1, 2015, Digital India is a campaign to ensure the Government's services are made available to citizens electronically by improving online infrastructure and increasing internet connectivity.
 
• It aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy through initiatives like Digital Locker, e-education, e-health, and more.
 
• The initiative also promotes digital literacy and aims to provide high-speed internet in all rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Makeup India**
 
 
• There is no initiative or campaign named "Makeup India" by the Government of India.
 
• This option is incorrect and possibly included to test the awareness of candidates about government schemes and initiatives.
